sample_reviews.author: James R.
sample_reviews.text: Fantastic service from start to finish. The engineer arrived on time, explained everything clearly and had our boiler replaced the same day. Highly recommend Smarter Heating and Plumbing.

sample_reviews.author: Sarah M.
sample_reviews.text: Called them out for an emergency heating issue in the middle of winter. They were with us within two hours and sorted the problem quickly. Excellent, professional and great value.

sample_reviews.author: David T.
sample_reviews.text: Used Smarter Heating for our annual boiler service. Thorough job, very tidy and gave us great advice on keeping our system efficient. Will definitely use again.

brand.usp: Smarter Heating and Plumbing delivers honest, expert gas and heating services across Liverpool with a focus on quality workmanship and transparent pricing. We treat every home like our own, ensuring you stay warm and safe all year round.
brand.hero_headline: Liverpool's Trusted Gas and Heating Experts
brand.about_paragraph: I'm a Gas Safe registered engineer based in Liverpool, passionate about delivering heating and plumbing solutions that genuinely make a difference to your home and comfort. At Smarter Heating and Plumbing, I pride myself on honest advice, fair pricing, and work carried out to the highest standard. Whether it's a new boiler installation, a routine service, or an emergency repair, I'm here to help.
